messages:
marie: Quick help needed 15m demo failing. Android client sees JSON.parse 'Unexpected end of JSON input' from our SSE POC. Happens ~10-20s after open. cc @sara @kevin

 sara: Do we know if customer proxies (APIGW/CDN) are in front? Paste client log + raw SSE concat.

 marie: They go through Akamai gateway. Client log:
```
E/SSE: JSON.parse Unexpected end of input
E/SSE: last_bytes=180 last_chunk='{"note":"Check blood pres'
```
 Raw SSE concat:
```
data: {"type":"note","payload":{"id":2,"note":"Check blood pres\n\n
data: sure taken"}
\n```

 kevin: Looks like the JSON is split across chunk boundaries. Likely gateway buffering or idle timeout. Short fixes: disable buffering on gateway for this route (streaming mode), ensure `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, use chunked transfer, flush per event, and add SSE comment keepalive every 8s (e.g. `: hb\n\n`) if gateway idle timeout <15s.

 marie: Customer's gateway timeout = 12s. We'll ask them to set keepalive <12s and enable streaming. Can Redwood add temporary heartbeat from our side for POC?

 kevin: We can patch demo backend to emit heartbeats for this tenant. I'll open internal ticket and push patch.

 ops-bot: :rotating_light: POC-9001 created and assigned to eng-platform (tag: sse-heartbeat).

 marie: Thanks! I'll coordinate with customer and update here after they toggle streaming mode.
